fdee86f160e6107594c0.en: [Seoul = Newsis] Byun Hae-jung = Korea also strengthens airport safety supervision to ensure that all domestic airports receive airport operation certificates, such as Japan and China. According to the authorities on the 20th, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport has announced the amendment of the Enforcement Decree and Enforcement Regulations of the Airport Facilities Act and is collecting opinions from all walks of life. This revision specifies the mandate of an amendment to the upper law that establishes a five-year validation system for airport operating certificates so that airport safety supervision can be performed in accordance with international standards. The airport operation certificate shall be issued by the airport operator after the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport inspects the airport's safety operation system.

This kind of gray zone infringement under the name of "scientific research" not only blatantly infringes China's sovereign rights under the "Exclusive Economic Sea Area and Continental Reef Layer Law", but also directly paves the way for its underwater operations and submarine navigation channels with "military and civilian use" hydrological mapping. However, in the face of this precisely designed gray area operation, Taiwan's front-line coast guard law enforcement is falling into a serious "traditional countermeasure failure" dilemma. In order to effectively defend the rights and interests of the sea, the government must take root from the two dimensions of "authorization mechanism for urgent handling" and "tactical transformation of the disposal target".
